title: AI video games are just 90's MMO's
author: fisj
selftext: I'm not the video author, but wanted to share.

comments.author: spracked
comments.body: https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-user_dungeon what about MUDs, aren't those closer to AI interaction

replies.author: fisj
replies.body:
My take from the video was his comparison of the technology needed for bringing early mmos into the polished and profitable form they became. Tho I think tying the comparison to a genre throws the argument off a bit.

IMHO, the least interesting thing AI will be used for is AI NPC conversations, but bringing back the creativity and open ended nature found in MUDs through AI, I could definitely see.
